text:
Ana: quick sync  we need a short benchmark narrative for next week's launch: focus = latency vs cost. prefer non-technical headline for broad reach + nerdy appendix for engs.
Rahul: agree. propose two-tier collateral: (A) social card + 60s explainer (B) deep-dive blog with methodology.
Sam: charts to include: cost per 1k tokens by serving mode, 95th pct latency comparison, and a small throughput per GPU comparison. keep labels normalized to 512 tokens.
Devon: wording: avoid 'benchmark' externally; call it 'performance snapshot' or 'cost-latency snapshot'. legal wants anyone claim be phrased as 'up to X' with method linked.
Ana: CTA ideas: "Try cost calculator" (self-serve) and "Book a 15-min demo" (sales). we should A/B these in paid social.
Rahul: routing: form asks "Primary priority" (Cost / Latency / Compliance). Cost -> automated calc email; Latency -> AE follow-up; Compliance -> enterprise. add hidden field for monthly token estimate.
Sam: design: two color lanes: Fast (blue) and Cost-optimized (green). GIF sequence: slider at 100/200/500ms showing $/1k changes.
Devon: infra: can you provide representative numbers for hosted/dedicated/private at 512-token window? anonymize. we only need median, 95th, and $/1k.
Ana: timeline: numbers by Wed EOD, creative mockups by Thu, required legal note in blog. Rahul will own ads.
Rahul: KPI for win: calculator engagement time >2 min or demo conversion rate >8% for mid-market. also watch form token estimates for triage.
Sam: microcopy suggestions: technical caption: "Match latency SLOs to unit cost across serving modes." non-technical: "Same app, different tradeoffs  pick faster or cheaper."
Devon: reminder  don't use specific customer savings claims in social. blog can show anonymized case studies with permission.
mktg-bot: reminder set for 1745300000 to review final assets.
Ana: great. I'll assemble a 3-slide deck (social card, GIF frames, blog sketch) and drop it here for review. :sparkles:
